title: Unit-normalized forward section projection composite
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring, let $r:V\to X$ and $i:X\to V$ satisfy $i\gg r=1_X$, and let $M\in D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X})$. Use the actual derived functors, projection map $\pi$, canonical direct-image section comparison $s:Ri_*Rr_*\cong\mathrm{id}$ (functors in order of application), of [def-sfb-module-projection-section-arrows], and section arrow $a_M$ of [def-sfb-module-section-projection-arrow]. Write $U=\Lambda_X$ for the tensor unit and $\rho_M:M\otimes^{\mathbf L}U\cong M$ for the right unitor. Define the forward endomorphism of $M$ by the following path, in order of traversal:
$$M\xrightarrow{\rho_M^{-1}}M\otimes U\xrightarrow{1\otimes s_U^{-1}}M\otimes Rr_*Ri_*U\xrightarrow{\pi_{r,M,Ri_*U}}Rr_*(Lr^*M\otimes Ri_*U)\xrightarrow{Rr_*(a_M)}Rr_*Ri_*M\xrightarrow{s_M}M.$$
This definition asserts no identity.
